meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 装上 iMessage 频道,可在本机 macOS(读取本机 iMessage 聊天记录)或远程 Photon 服务两种模式中选一种。它会自动复制适配器、注册、安装依赖、构建验证、配置环境变量并重启服务,使 iMessage 消息能接入 Claude。
howto.when: 当你说“add imessage”“connect imessage”或“imessage via photon”等触发词时,该技能会接管,开始配置 iMessage 频道。

say.text: 帮我把 iMessage 接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 技能会启动,先询问选择本地还是远程模式。
会检查 macOS 并引导你授予完全磁盘访问权限。

say.text: 通过 Photon 接入 iMessage
say.note: 会引导你填写 Photon 服务器地址和 API 密钥。

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw, either local (macOS, reads this Mac's chat.db) or remote (via Photon API). Copies the adapter, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, builds, validates, configures env, restarts, and wires your iMessage handle.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", etc., or when you ask to set up iMessage via Photon.

say_en.note: Starts the skill, which asks you to pick local or remote mode.
Checks for macOS and guides you through granting Full Disk Access.
Walks you through entering the Photon server URL and API key.
